from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CreditImpairmentItem(BaseModel):
    """Credit impairment loss item from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose report this is")
    company_stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/certificate code of the company if provided")
    credit_impairment_loss: float | None = Field(description="Credit impairment loss amount for the period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the amount, e.g., 'yuan' or '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    credit_impairment_items: list[CreditImpairmentItem]
